## FA-012 / ZEUS-97f3257c362a revision 2 — Refs #13

### Defect (upstream, agreed in cross-review)
The evaluator's "precision" was specificity (TN/(TN+FP)); positives were judged as `match AND winner` while negatives were judged as `match` only; the real CLI passed with zero negatives, let an unqualified rival produce FAIL_RECALL, and favored the target on ties. The production hook uses different candidates, path signals, stack filters, pipeline boosts and body budgets, and its telemetry `top5`/`matched_count` describe pre-budget candidates — so an evaluator PASS proves neither model-input arrival nor behavior. Consensus: state what is measured — raw match, rank, body arrival, actual behavior — with separate confusion matrices and denominators.

### Zeus
The routing manifest already records per-skill `tier` and `rendered_hash`, but the per-execution history observation carried only scores/dimensions, so `skill_telemetry_audit` could count matches but not deliveries (same shape as upstream's pre-budget top5).
- `adapters/skill_history._prepare_history`: observations now carry `tier` and `rendered_hash` (fingerprint keys unchanged → replays still deduplicate).
- `application/skill_history.record`: `tier` restricted to the five delivery tiers; `rendered_hash` non-empty when present.
- `domain/skill_audit.audit_history`: per skill `rank_first_count` and `delivery{full, pointer, external_pointer, unmatched, legacy, unknown}` (unknown = pre-tier observations); report-level `measurement_targets` (`raw_match`, `rank`, `body_arrival`, `behavior = not measured by telemetry`); no blended precision/recall.
- `adapters/skill_audit.render_text`: `ranked first: m/n; delivered full body: k, pointer: p, tier unknown: u (match != delivery != behavior)`.
- `docs/contracts.md` (`INV-SKILL-HISTORY-001`), `docs/zeus/implementation/skill-measurement-targets-001/README.md`.

### Verification
| | Result |
|---|---|
| `test_match_rank_and_body_arrival_are_separate_counts_not_one_precision`: two skills across three observations with score inversions and a tie → count/rank-first/delivery differ per target; no "precision" in the report; behavior declared unmeasured; text line pinned | pass |
| `test_recorded_observations_keep_tier_and_reject_unknown_tiers` (+ replay of the same selection with tier added is not a new observation) | pass |
| `test_real_skill_history_annotation_and_recovery_survive_other_task_observation` (actual Executor path with fixture runtime): observations carry tier/rendered hash; audit `delivery['full']` equals actual full deliveries | pass |
| Negative control: revert `skill_audit.py`, `skill_history.py` (adapter+application), `adapters/skill_audit.py` to `origin/main` | the 3 checks fail |
| Skill modules (`test_skill_audit`, `test_skill_history`, `test_project_skills`, `test_skill_import`, `test_skill_routing`) | 72 passed, 1 skipped |
| Windows full `uv run pytest -q` (Python 3.12.14) / `ruff check` | 919 passed, 305 skipped / clean — the first run had one unrelated failure in `test_github_tickets.py::test_external_title_change_is_preserved_and_invalidates_synced_status[memory]`, which passed on the full rerun and on 3 isolated reruns (time-dependent flake, also passes on unmodified main) |
| Linux path | this PR's ubuntu CI matrix |

### Not claimed
"Actual behavior" is declared unmeasurable by telemetry; no behavior measurement is added (it comes from real model output and human acceptance, INV-RESEARCH-003). No target-label evaluator like upstream's `skill_trigger_eval` exists in Zeus; the contract only records that any such evaluator must use the production candidate/matching/injection path. Issue closure follows the ledger acceptance path (#30) and is a separate step after this PR; the GitHub issue stays OPEN until that acceptance.
